command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_conduction_2d.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: 2 by 8 homogeneous slab with T=305+x+t, C=2, unit conductivity and H=4. Two row patterns +x and -x switch to -2x and +2x at t=0.125 s, giving ambient heat -0.625 times the initial pattern through 0.5 s. Prescribed source energy is 1 J/m³ minus this exchange. Compute the energy residual from solver-reported storage, exchange, source heat and section heat. Options 0,1,2 denote Crank-Nicolson, Rannacher and SDIRK2. A separate two-interval scalar source 2^-50*(1-4t) W/m³ with zero ambient is checked against its signed analytical integral. The reusable callback buffer test uses a unit power ramp on an insulated slab.
